user.title: LIFX Switch Backlight
user.description: Found LIFX Switches on your network.

manual.title: Add a LIFX Switch
manual.description: No new switch was found automatically. Enter its IP address.

data_description.host: Give the switch a fixed IP address in your router so it's always found at the same address.

error.cannot_connect: No LIFX device answered at this address.
error.not_a_switch: This LIFX device isn't a switch (it has no backlight settings).

abort.already_configured: This switch is already set up.

communication_error.message: Couldn't reach the LIFX Switch at {host}.

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} isn't a loaded LIFX Switch.

set_backlight.name: Set backlight
set_backlight.description: Sets the backlight colors and haptic feedback of one or more LIFX Switches. Fields you leave out keep their current value.

haptic_duration_ms.name: Haptic feedback
haptic_duration_ms.description: How long each button vibrates when pressed. 0 turns it off.

on_rgb_color.name: On color: color picker
on_rgb_color.description: Picks the backlight color when the load is on. Brightness is set separately.

on_color_temp_kelvin.name: On color: white temperature
on_color_temp_kelvin.description: Sets a white backlight from warm to cold when the load is on.

on_hue.name: On color: hue
on_hue.description: Hue of the backlight when the load is on.

on_saturation.name: On color: saturation
on_saturation.description: Saturation of the backlight when the load is on. 0 gives white at the set color temperature.

on_brightness.name: On color: brightness
on_brightness.description: Brightness of the backlight when the load is on.

on_kelvin.name: On color: color temperature
on_kelvin.description: Color temperature of the backlight when the load is on.

off_rgb_color.name: Off color: color picker
off_rgb_color.description: Picks the backlight color when the load is off. Brightness is set separately.

off_color_temp_kelvin.name: Off color: white temperature
off_color_temp_kelvin.description: Sets a white backlight from warm to cold when the load is off.

off_hue.name: Off color: hue
off_hue.description: Hue of the backlight when the load is off.

off_saturation.name: Off color: saturation
off_saturation.description: Saturation of the backlight when the load is off. 0 gives white at the set color temperature.

off_brightness.name: Off color: brightness
off_brightness.description: Brightness of the backlight when the load is off.

off_kelvin.name: Off color: color temperature
off_kelvin.description: Color temperature of the backlight when the load is off.
